title: LMM Engine ESP build-pack artifacts
description: JSON Schemas for every artifact adapters/destinations/build writes: create-API request bodies (Klaviyo flow, segment and template; HubSpot automation v4 workflow; Salesforce Marketing Cloud journey), the Braze /canvas/duplicate request, and the build sheet for platforms without a create API. Each is written from the vendor's documented shape (Klaviyo's from its official OpenAPI spec, revision 2026-10-15). x-endpoint records the endpoint, the documentation and its confidence; x-unverified names every field the docs do not confirm. Placeholders <<kind:key>> are strings until lcm build --create resolves them.
